Eberl faced challenges after taking over Bayern’s transfer dealings in February 2024, including a difficult search for a new coach. He eventually appointed Vincent Kompany, who led Bayern to back-to-back Bundesliga titles. Dreesen became CEO in May 2023 after Oliver Kahn's dismissal.
